packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/cond.Condition.constructor@202: Takes an operator, field name, raw value, and optional options, and throws via `assert` if the field has no registered type, the type is unknown, the operator is invalid for the field, or a non-nullable type receives a null/undefined value (or an empty string for string types). On success it stores the raw value as both `rawValue` and `unparsedValue`, the op, field, options, and type name, and sets `value` to the result of the type's `parse` function (or the raw value if the type has no parser).
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/cond.Condition.eval@239: Takes an object record and returns a boolean indicating whether the condition matches the value at `object[this.field]`. For string fields a null or undefined value is treated as an empty string, an undefined value otherwise returns false, and string values are lowercased before comparison. For number fields with `outflow` or `inflow` options, the value is negated (outflow) or rejected when its sign is wrong, returning false early. Operators not handled by the switch, and invalid regular expressions in `matches`, return false; `onBudget` and `offBudget` return false when `object._account` is missing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/cond.Condition.getValue@449: Takes no arguments and returns the parsed `value` stored on the condition at construction time, without modification.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/cond.Condition.serialize@453: Takes no arguments and returns a plain object with `op`, `field`, `value` set to the original unparsed value passed to the constructor, and `type` set to the type name. It includes an `options` property only when the condition's options are truthy.

packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.resetState@65: Replaces the module-level allRules with an empty Map and creates new firstcharIndexer (keyed on imported_payee, firstchar method) and payeeIndexer (keyed on payee). Takes no arguments and returns nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.invert@76: Returns a new object whose keys are the input's values and whose values are the input's keys, with later entries overwriting earlier ones on duplicate values. The input is not modified.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.fromInternalField@87: Returns a shallow copy of the given object with its field replaced by the public name mapped from the internal schema field, or left unchanged when no mapping exists.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.toInternalField@94: Returns a shallow copy of the given object with its field replaced by the internal schema column name, or left unchanged when no mapping exists.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.parseArray@101: Parses a string as JSON (non-string input is used as-is) and returns the resulting array. Throws a RuleError of type 'internal' if parsing fails or the value is not an array.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.parseConditionsOrActions@115: Returns an empty array for a falsy input; otherwise parses the input as an array via parseArray and maps each item through fromInternalField.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.serializeConditionsOrActions@119: Maps each item through toInternalField and returns the resulting array as a JSON string.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.makeRule@170: Builds a Rule from ruleModel.toJS(data) and returns null if construction throws a RuleError (logging a warning); other errors are rethrown. On success, it migrates the rule's ids using the current mappings before returning it.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.loadRules@190: Resets state, then loads every non-tombstoned rule with non-null conditions and actions from the database, converting legacy stages 'cleanup' and 'modify' to 'pre'. Each successfully built rule is added to allRules and both indexers, and the sync listener is re-registered after removing any previous one. Returns a Promise resolving to nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRules@219: Returns a new array containing all rules currently in allRules.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.insertRule@224: Validates the rule in create mode, then inserts it into the rules table with a generated UUID and returns the result of db.insertWithUUID.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updateRule@231: Validates the rule in update mode, checking only the fields present, then updates its row in the rules table and returns the result of db.update.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.deleteRule@236: Returns false without deleting if any schedule references the rule id. Otherwise it deletes the rule row and returns true.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.onApplySync@252: Applies synced rule changes to allRules and both indexers: tombstoned rules are removed, and other changed rules are rebuilt and replace any previously indexed version. If any changed table name contains 'mapping', every in-memory rule's ids are re-migrated against the current mappings.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRuleIdFromScheduleId@293: Returns the rule id attached to the schedule with the given id, or null if no such schedule exists or its rule value is null or empty.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getAllRuleIdsFromSchedules@304: Returns the non-empty rule ids from all schedules, omitting the excluded id. Duplicates are not removed.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.runRules@323: Ensures formula preferences are loaded, then applies the ranked candidate rules in sequence to a copy of the transaction and returns the finalized result. Missing payee or category fields are matched as null and removed from the result if still null; the running balance is fetched only when a rule that runs references it. When the transaction is linked to a schedule, that schedule's rule runs unconditionally and other schedule-linked rules are skipped; the category group is refreshed after each rule. The input transaction object is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.conditionSpecialCases@460: Returns null for null input and otherwise returns the condition unchanged unless it is an 'is' or 'isNot' on category with a null value. For those cases it returns an 'and' condition that wraps the original with extra checks: 'is' adds transfer is false and parent is false, and 'isNot' adds parent is false.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.conditionsToAQL@493: Converts conditions (Condition instances or plain objects) into AQL filter objects and returns { filters, errors }. Invalid plain conditions are dropped and their error types recorded, special cases are applied when enabled, and recurring 'is' dates are expanded up to recurDateBounds occurrences. Throws on an unhandled operator.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.applyActions@755: Parses the actions into Action instances and returns null if any fail to parse. It then prepares the transactions (including the balance only when an action references it), prefetches balanceOf values, runs the actions, ungroups and finalizes the results, and returns the result of batchUpdateTransactions.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRulesForPayee@830: Returns the ranked, deduplicated rules whose payee-indexed id equals the given payee id.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getIsSetterRules@841: Generator that yields the serialized rules in the given stage that have exactly one 'set' action on actionField (matching actionValue when provided) and exactly one 'is' or 'isNot' condition on condField (matching condValue when provided). It yields nothing else.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getOneOfSetterRules@868: Generator that yields the serialized rules in the given stage that have exactly one 'set' action on actionField and exactly one 'oneOf' condition on condField. The action value must equal actionValue when it is non-null, and the condition's array must contain condValue when it is non-null.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updatePayeeRenameRule@896: If a 'pre' stage oneOf imported_payee rule setting payee exists, it merges the non-empty fromNames into that rule's condition values, updates the rule, and returns its id. Otherwise it inserts a new 'pre' stage rule mapping fromNames to the payee and returns the result of insertRule.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getProbableCategory@932: Counts occurrences of each truthy category and returns the category with the highest count, using the first such category in list order on ties, if that count is at least 3; otherwise returns null. Throws on an empty array.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updateCategoryRules@952: Returns immediately for an empty list. Otherwise, for each payee of the given transactions, it examines that payee's five most recent eligible transactions in a window from 180 days back to 180 days ahead; if one of the given transactions is among them and a probable category exists, it updates the payee's existing 'is' category rules whose action differs, or inserts a new stage-null rule when no matching rule of either kind exists.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRunningBalanceBeforeTransaction@1072: Returns the sum of amounts of non-parent transactions in the account that come before the given transaction, excluding its own id. Earlier dates count, and on the same date, lower sort_order counts; null sort_order rows are ordered after ordered rows and tie-broken by id. The date defaults to currentDay(), and the result is 0 when the sum is null.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.prefetchBalanceOfForTransaction@1114: Collects the distinct BALANCE_OF literals from the formulas and returns a Map from each literal to the running balance before the transaction for its resolved account. Literals with no resolvable account map to 0.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.actionsReferenceBalance@1146: Returns true if any action's template or formula string contains the word 'balance' matched case-insensitively with word boundaries. A BALANCE_OF reference does not count.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.prepareTransactionForRules@1158: Returns a new object copying the transaction and adding payee_name, _account, _account_name, balance, _category_name and category_group where the lookups succeed. The balance is set to 0, or to the running balance when includeBalance is true and an account is present. Accounts come from the supplied map when available and from the database otherwise; the input is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.resolvePayeeNameForRules@1210: When the object has a payee_name key and payee is 'new', it sets payee to the id of the payee with that name, inserting one if needed, or to null when payee_name is empty. Otherwise it does nothing. It mutates the given object.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.refreshCategoryGroupIfChanged@1239: If trans.category equals lastCategoryId, it returns that value without any lookup. Otherwise it sets trans.category_group from the category's cat_group (or deletes the property when there is no category) and returns the current category id.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.finalizeTransactionForRules@1258: Mutates and returns the transaction after resolving a 'new' payee name when payee_name is present, then deletes the synthetic fields payee_name, balance, category_group and _balanceOfPrefetched, and the parent_* fields. Balance, _balanceOfPrefetched and parent_* fields are also removed from each subtransaction.

packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.isValidOp@99: Takes a field key and an operation and returns a boolean. It returns false if the field has no entry in FIELD_TYPES or if the op is in that field's disallowedOps. Otherwise it returns true when the op is in the field's type ops list or in the field's internalOps set, and false in all other cases.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.getValidOps@110: Takes a field key and returns a new array of operations. It returns an empty array for an unknown field. Otherwise it returns the field type's ops from TYPE_INFO, in their original order, with the field's disallowedOps removed. internalOps are not included.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.deserializeField@120: Takes a field name string and returns an object with a `field` property. 'amount-inflow' maps to { field: 'amount', options: { inflow: true } } and 'amount-outflow' maps to { field: 'amount', options: { outflow: true } }. Any other input returns { field } with the input unchanged.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.getFieldError@130: Takes an error type string and returns a fixed user-facing message string. 'no-null', 'no-empty-array' and 'no-empty-string' share the message 'Value cannot be empty'. Any unrecognized type returns the generic internal-error message.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.sortNumbers@153: Takes two values and returns a new two-element array containing them ordered ascending by the `<` operator. If the first is strictly less than the second, it returns them in that order; otherwise it returns [num2, num1]. The inputs are not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.parse@160: Takes a rule item and returns a parsed item without mutating the input. For a 'set-split-amount' op, a fixed-amount method returns a shallow copy, while any other method returns the same object reference unchanged. For other items, 'number' returns a shallow copy; 'string' returns a copy whose value is '' when the value is null or undefined; 'boolean' returns a copy with the value unchanged; any other type returns a copy with `error` set to null.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.unparse@186: Takes a rule item and returns a copy with its `error` and `inputKey` properties removed, without mutating the input. For 'set-split-amount', fixed-amount returns the copy as is, fixed-percent returns the copy with `value` converted by parseFloat when it is truthy (falsy values pass through unchanged), and other methods return the stripped item. For other types, 'number' returns the copy, 'string' turns a null or undefined value into '', 'boolean' turns a null or undefined value into false, and other types return the stripped item.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.makeValue@220: Takes a value and a condition object and returns a new condition object with `error` set to null and a `value` property set. For 'oneOf' and 'notOneOf' ops, the value is the input if truthy, otherwise an empty array. For number-typed conditions, a null or undefined value becomes 0. In all other cases the value is used as given. The condition object is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts.getApproxNumberThreshold@234: Takes a number and returns Math.round of its absolute value multiplied by 0.075. The result is a non-negative integer.

packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.assert@12: Takes a test value, an error type string, and a message string. If the test value is falsy, it throws a RuleError with that type and message; otherwise it returns nothing and narrows the test value to truthy for the caller.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.computeScore@38: Takes a Rule and returns a number: the sum of OP_SCORES for each condition's op, where an op with no score entry is logged and contributes 0. If every condition's op is one of is, isNot, isapprox, oneOf, or notOneOf (true for an empty condition list), the sum is doubled; otherwise the plain sum is returned.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule._rankRules@63: Takes an array of Rules and returns a new array (the input is not mutated) sorted by ascending computed score, with ties broken by ascending string comparison of rule ids, so the order is independent of the input order. Each rule's score is computed once before sorting.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.rankRules@87: Takes an iterable of Rules and returns a new array made by concatenating the ranked 'pre' rules, the ranked normal rules (every stage other than 'pre' or 'post'), and the ranked 'post' rules, each group ordered by _rankRules.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.migrateIds@112: Takes a Rule and a map of id mappings and mutates the rule in place. For id-type 'is' and 'isNot' conditions, it sets value to the mapped rawValue (or rawValue when no mapping exists) and sets unparsedValue to the same value; for 'oneOf' and 'notOneOf' it maps each rawValue element, deduplicates the result preserving first-occurrence order into value, and sets unparsedValue to a copy of it. For id-type 'set' actions it sets value to the mapped rawValue or rawValue. rawValue fields and all other conditions and actions are left unchanged, and it returns nothing.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.iterateIds@163: Takes an array of Rules, a field name, and a callback that receives a rule and an id and may return a truthy value. For each rule in order, it calls the callback with each current value of id-type conditions on that field (for is, isNot, oneOf, notOneOf); a truthy return skips the rest of that rule's conditions and actions and moves to the next rule. It then calls the callback with the value of each id-type 'set' action on that field, and a truthy return stops only the action loop for that rule. It returns nothing and does not modify the rules.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseRecurDate@220: Takes a recurrence description and returns an object with type 'recur' and an RSchedule built from the converted rrules, with skipWeekend and weekendSolve taken from the description's skipWeekend and weekendSolveMode fields. If conversion or construction throws, it rethrows a RuleError with type 'parse-recur-date' and the original error message.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseDateString@239: Takes a value and returns null if it is not a string. For strings of length 10, 7, or 4, it checks that the string is a valid ISO date when read as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-01, or YYYY-01-01 respectively, and returns { type: 'date', date }, { type: 'month', date }, or { type: 'year', date } with the original string when valid. It returns null for invalid strings and for any other length.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseBetweenAmount@268: Takes an object with num1 and num2 fields and returns { type: 'between', num1, num2 } when both fields have typeof 'number'; otherwise it returns null. It does not check for NaN or ordering of the two values.
